items.title: Last Stream
items.overview: Desperate for views, a fading streamer stages a fake haunting connected to an unsolved case. The stream spirals into a real-time nightmare watched by tens of thousands and someone in the chat seems to know exactly how the night will end.

items.title: He’s Dating a Boldstar
items.overview: Jeboy, a mild-mannered hotel employee, falls for a woman he believes is an ordinary guest—until he discovers she is a “bold star,” a Filipino term for an adult entertainer.

items.title: Instadocs: Jane Doe v. Cornell
items.overview: Instadocs goes inside the rape investigation and Jane Doe lawsuit at Cornell University, with the student journalists at the forefront of the story.

items.title: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
items.overview: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

items.title: Rise of the Empire
items.overview: Upon returning home from his Grand Embassy, Peter the Great enters into a prolonged war with Sweden to secure access to the Baltic Sea. His path to victory is paved with setbacks, treachery, and deceit. Only by overcoming these challenges will he become Emperor, find true love, and establish Russia as a great empire.

items.title: Red Crown
items.overview: Twenty-five contestants compete for a P25 million cash prize at the 25th-anniversary "Queen of the Islands" pageant.

items.title: Eres especial
items.overview: A man discovers that being "special" isn't always a gift...

items.title: Çatlı 2
items.overview: Following an attack in Paris, Abdullah Çatlı is imprisoned in France, where he faces mounting danger as his family becomes a target on the outside. Caught amid political tensions and escalating pressure across Europe, he navigates a perilous struggle to protect his loved ones and find a way back home.

items.title: God Laughs
items.overview: In the heart of the 17th century, Friar Leopoldo da Casamacchia recounts the Gospel with a joy and freedom never seen before. While the Church speaks in Latin, he speaks to the people of a God who is close to them, capable of bringing comfort, hope, and even of laughing alongside them. His voice spreads from village to village, winning over thousands of people and emptying the churches. The echo of his message reaches as far as Rome, where the Pope entrusts the case to Cardinal Maculani, the most influential inquisitor of the time. What begins as a trial turns into an unexpected confrontation, capable of shaking seemingly unshakable convictions. While Leopoldo’s fate seems sealed, doubt begins to change even those who judge him. Because you can silence a voice, but not what that voice has left behind in others.

items.title: The Cull
items.overview: Wrongly imprisoned for his mother’s murder, Niall is finally released, having found God and renounced a life of violence and addiction. Retreating to a remote woodland cabin seeking redemption and the truth behind her death, he finds a hostile community ruled by a ruthless family, where every encounter deepens the mystery surrounding his mother’s past. As brutal violence erupts and terrifying visions blur the line between nightmare and reality, Niall uncovers a sinister legacy of witchcraft, blood sacrifice and forbidden ritual. Something has been patiently waiting in the forest, and its hunger for vengeance can only be satisfied with blood.

items.title: #Cult
items.overview: A group of young boys head to a party expecting a night of fun, but soon discover the reality is far darker than they imagined. What starts as excitement spirals into terror, pushing them into a brutal fight for survival.

items.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
items.overview: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. Who Killed Alex Odeh? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

items.title: Enemy Of The Smuggler
items.overview: Inspired by real customs investigations, a relentless battle unfolds against organized smuggling networks, exposing the hidden world of coastal operations, airport cartels and the officers determined to stop them.

items.title: Spring
items.overview: A young couple's peaceful getaway to a remote hilltop bungalow takes a terrifying turn as mysterious events unfold. As hidden secrets emerge, their seemingly perfect life is threatened by fear and suspense.

items.title: The Hollow
items.overview: After a botched robbery, Malik and Shad return to The Hollow with an unexpected presence in tow. As a detective closes in, secrets begin to surface.

items.title: Tame
items.overview: In a remote village where bulls are trained through fear and tradition, a young girl held captive by her family seeks the power of an ancient spirit for liberation, employing the same cruel techniques used to control her.

items.title: Les 50 décisions qui ont coulé la France
Ugly Duckling Ms. Maeng
items.overview: Ms. Maeng, a small-town teacher, unexpectedly joins the team responsible for creating South Korea’s most important exam: the College Scholastic Ability Test. She thought it would be all about academic prestige and scholarly debate but instead finds herself locked away under spy-level security, her phone confiscated and surrounded by office politics. Can this unlikely underdog turn test stress into test success, or just test everyone's patience?

items.title: Ten Reasons to Die After You
items.overview: Devastated by the tragic death of her best friend, Gabriela discovers that she left behind an unexpected parting gift: ten letters containing challenges designed to help her overcome her grief.

items.title: MEAT
items.overview: A homeless family accepts shelter in a luxurious, remote ranch. What they don’t know is that their arrival was anticipated, and the baby they’re expecting is the main course of a hungry system.

items.title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in São Paulo
items.overview: The Latin American leg of BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ reaches the big screen through a delayed presentation of the São Paulo concert. It brings the scale and excitement of BTS’s stadium performance into the cinema, offering fans a communal live-viewing experience shaped by the energy of a packed Brazilian venue.

items.title: VHS
items.overview: VIVA HORROR STORIES is a 3-in-1 horror anthology where every story has a secret, every secret has a price, and every nightmare leads to terror. A cheerleader is haunted by a sinister presence on campus; a seemingly perfect romance hides a horrifying secret; and a celebrity couple faces an unthinkable choice when their child is born disfigured. Three terrifying stories. Three unforgettable nightmares. One anthology that will make you scream

items.title: Nakhrewaalii
items.overview: Sumit Mishra cross-dresses as a woman to win over his love interest, Paridhi.

items.title: Biermann
items.overview: Portrait of the German-German singer-songwriter and intellectual Wolf Biermann, whose famous Cologne concert in 1976 made German history.

items.title: Last Dinner
items.overview: The film focuses on what it means to truly love someone "in sickness and in health." In the story, talented pianist Canan embarks on a passionate affair with Bekir, a mysterious agent, after saving his life. However, Bekir suddenly disappears. When he returns years later, he finds Canan married someone else. This encounter rekindles a love that had been interrupted years before. Canan is forced to make an impossible choice between her past passion and her present-day loyalty.

items.title: Up Again
items.overview: A triple jump on ice skates lasts just a few seconds, but requires years of physical training and mental isolation. This time-lapse portrait of Barbora Vránková, three-time Czech figure skating champion, captures a pivotal period in her life between the ages of fifteen and eighteen. Her days are filled with online lessons, physiotherapy sessions and, above all, a rigorous training routine. The camera, synchronised with the protagonist’s movements, takes us straight onto the ice, where the screech of blades and the thumping of pop hits blend with the shouts of her coaches. Without any contrived pathos, the film follows how, fall after fall, the young athlete works her way towards precision on the ice and autonomy off it.

items.title: Ciudad de muertos
items.overview: Enrique Metinides, renowned crime photographer, discovers his passion as a child when his camera captures a haunting image of death. This obsession with documenting tragedy shapes his career and transforms his work into art. But as a mysterious figure begins appearing in his photographs, Enrique unravels a chilling secret linking his lens to the shadows of politics and the supernatural.

items.title: Stories That Made Us with George Stroumboulopoulos
items.overview: George Stroumboulopoulos embarks on a cross-Canada road trip uncovering the films and TV shows that helped shape our national identity.

items.title: Matīss Kaža. The Impossible Self-Portrait
items.overview: The film follows Matīss Kaža during a period when his professional life has taken him from one country and continent to another. Together with Gints Zilbalodis, the director of the film Flow (Straume), he spent nearly a year caught in a whirlwind of international award ceremonies, events, and meetings—a journey that included the film’s path to the Academy Awards. Yet, this is only one facet of Kaža’s life and work. During the same period, he made his debut as a theatre director at three different venues in Riga and crafted the Lielais Kristaps (Latvian National Film Awards) and Spēlmaņu nakts (Latvian Theatre Awards) ceremonies as multimedia performances. The camera follows Kaža as he constantly creates, travels, and engages in new projects, all while maintaining an ironic perspective on both himself and the world around him.

items.title: Baltic UXO
items.overview: 1.6 million tons of unexploded military munition (UXO) were dumped into the Baltic and Northern Seas after the Second World War. A brooding and meditative cinematic journey observes the effects this has on nature and people around the Baltic.

items.title: The SAS
items.overview: On February 20th, 2016, a college student's friend goes missing. Through phone recordings, we recall the event that led up to his disappearance.

items.title: Ralph's Perfekt Christmas
items.overview: To win back his wife, Christmas-obsessed Ralph concocts a crazy plan to kidnap the washed-up child star of his favorite Christmas movie. His scheme goes awry and spirals darkly out of control in an outrageous dark comedy with a horror twist that reveals two sides of one very desperate man determined to have his "Perfekt Christmas," no matter what - even if it lands him on the Naughty List.

items.title: 109 Billion Followers
items.overview: A lonely film student documents a man who believes that he’s the Grim Reaper, as he leads her on a magical journey to meet herself as a teen, as a young girl, and as an infant, to recover her ability to love – while she still can.

items.title: Der Geier – Blut und Zweifel
items.overview: A seasonal worker is found murdered with a crossbow in the mountains of Bad Gastein. For former witness protection agent Lukas Geier, the case brings back a dark past. Racing against Detective Franziska Conte, he must uncover whether his former client is being framed or if he saved the wrong man.

items.title: Les monstres
items.overview: Car broken down, a couple dreads the monsters lurking in the night.

items.title: Omega
items.overview: After surviving a catastrophic tsunami, Raven is exiled to a remote prison island inhabited by colossal creatures known as Omegas. But when a new terror emerges, she must stop history from repeating itself - even if it costs her freedom.

items.title: Medley
items.overview: Lola (16) is a lonely girl marked by a trauma that has followed her since childhood: the mysterious absence of her father. A talented swimmer with a vast collection of medals, Lola keeps a curious secret, she cannot swim the butterfly stroke. She has a strained relationship with her mother, and after one of their arguments she decides to spend her vacation alone in her uncle's town. There, the teenager's life changes radically she falls in love with Gabriel, makes new friends, and joins the town's struggling swim team. Now, every time Lola is in the water, these new emotions stir memories from her past. On the eve of an important championship, Lola finds herself facing fears and traumas she never expected, including the truth about her father's death.

items.title: Pulavar
items.overview: A unique retired police officer uses storytelling and his understanding of the human mind to uncover the truth behind crimes committed by criminals who refuse to confess, even after facing beatings and threats.

items.title: A Good Hand Wasted
items.overview: A luxury island getaway turns deadly when six friends join a mysterious dealer's poker game, where every losing hand means a round of Russian roulette.

items.title: Das Geheimnis der gestohlenen Maske
items.overview: Does the mask of the Makonde really have magic powers and can it settle the terrible quarrel between Johanna and her best friend? Johanna desperately needs the mask, but before her eyes it is stolen from Leipzig's Grassi Museum and Grandpa Kito is considered the prime suspect! Kito has just appeared from Tanzania and wants the mask, brutally stolen in colonial times, to return to his village. For Johanna, there is more at stake than unmasking the real thief - she must find her own identity.

items.title: Les Duos Impossibles de Jérémy Ferrari : 11ème édition - 1ère partie
Greatest Performance
items.overview: During a film shoot where abuse is disguised as artistic direction, a comeback actress commits a devastating performance to survive, exposing how cinema can construct and legitimize violence.  In Ang Lihim ni Teresa (Teresa's Secret), she enters a set where authority is absolute and cruelty is framed as discipline. As production unfolds, she loses control over body, emotion, and authorship, where survival is mistaken for consent.  When violence escalates, she chooses to live, burying the truth as the director’s collapse is rewritten as myth. The set becomes a crime scene without witnesses.  In the aftermath, she is praised for her “courage” while a sound technician retreats into silence. At a commemorative screening, celebration fractures, revealing cinema’s ability to transform violence into narrative and absolution.  The myth of the Kataw appears briefly through Ang Lihim ng Kataw (The Secret of Kataw).

items.title: The Doll Ghawiah
items.overview: It all began with an accident on Babakan Siliwangi Road. Nala encountered a mysterious little girl and her doll in the Babakan Siliwangi forest. The doll’s name was Ghawiah, which means “lost.” Ever since that accident, many strange occurrences have begun to haunt the local residents.

items.title: The Suicide Squad: Is It Canon? The Official Podcast
items.overview: In this one-episode special, James Gunn, Jennifer Holland and Steve Agee revisit The Suicide Squad and determine what is and is not canon moving forward in the DC Universe.

items.title: Lionheart
items.overview: Having grown up in the suburbs of Copenhagen, Luan knows the underworld and its rules better than any other life. That’s where he's belonged all his life. Now he wants to get out. The idea is simple. The reality is anything but. Old ties are not severed by a single decision. Issa has been by Luan's side since childhood, almost like a brother in a world where loyalty matters more than blood. A new beginning is not like putting on a clean shirt. You can change your address, your clothes and the company you keep, but the old rules remain. The body remembers how to stand. The eyes know who to trust.

items.title: Arrow
items.overview: On his first Boy Scout camping trip, 12 year old Wesley tries to win back his best friend by joining the coveted (and top secret) Order of the Arrow.

items.title: Journey There
items.overview: Chun-hee is left alone in the world after the sudden death of her husband. Faced with her own illness, she puts her life in order, but she intends to keep the appointment she made with her husband for an assisted suicide.

items.title: PH1SHed_
items.overview: An ethical hacker sticks up for a friend who fell victim to a phishing scam, but finds herself descending into paranoia as she gets caught up in a risky game of cat and mouse with a dangerous blackhat cyber criminal.

items.title: NWE: From Italy to the World
items.overview: A journey behind the scenes of European wrestling. Amid spectacle and sacrifice, we follow the vision of NWE founder Roberto Indiano, the return of Ultimate Warrior, and the stories of extraordinary athletes. An intimate, ironic, and compelling account that—through moments of humor, adrenaline, and behind-the-scenes insights—reveals the men behind the masks and the rebirth of a passion for the sport that has never faded.

items.title: Eisgrab - Das Haus am Gletscher
items.overview: A couple want to sell their house on a glacier. A potential buyer, who suffers a fainting spell during the viewing, is immediately accommodated in the guest room. She behaves strangely, sneaking into the couple's bed at night and seems to have a connection to the glacier area.

items.title: The Waters
items.overview: Nora's life takes an unexpected turn at the age of 43. After breaking up with her partner, she returns to the spring of her childhood with the hope that her waters will help her cure all her ills. Her friends Antía and Marta are not willing to leave her alone and together they will make a decision that will change everything: reinvent their idea of family and build a new beginning based on friendship.

items.title: Glückspilze isst man nicht
items.overview: The eccentric scientist Frieda Hofstätter is on the verge of being cast aside. Then the Valkyrie Wolkentruth appears to take her to Valhalla. But Frieda refuses and strikes a deal: Wolkentruth must help her save Frieda’s CO2-storing miracle mushroom. Only then may she take Frieda with her. Together, they race against time—and perhaps for the future of the world.

items.title: One Night Stand
items.overview: A married man's reckless decision to cheat during a night out spirals into a deadly nightmare when his mysterious hookup turns out to be a calculated serial killer targeting unfaithful men. As she embeds herself deeper into his life-stalking him, infiltrating his workplace, and getting dangerously close to his pregnant wife-he's forced to confront the consequences of his betrayal before everything he loves is destroyed.

items.title: Moscow Cairo
items.overview: In the 90s, and following the dissolution of the Soviet Union and the resulting conflicts, four Russian girls travel to Egypt and start to mingle in the Egyptian society, developing a shared admiration towards it in a way that makes them unwilling to return to their homeland.

items.title: The Evil Inside
items.overview: Once a showbiz icon in Taiwan, Ho Jen-jen—better known as Golden Phoenix—vanished after reckless gambling left her drowning in debt. She abandoned her young daughter, severing all ties. Years later, she collapses and wakes up in a sinister nursing home. Beneath the facility’s eerie calm lurks "Death Bet,” a twisted game where terminal patients' lifespans are gambled away. Desperate to escape and find her daughter, she soon realizes the true horror has yet to unfold, and the most harrowing secret is still waiting to be revealed.

items.title: Arthur & Clara
items.overview: Pretentious filmmaker Arthur and entitled high-profile actress Clara find themselves at the same rural farmhouse, to escape from their individual pressures. As they reluctantly start to connect, their shared vulnerability leads them on an accidental journey of self-discovery, revealing what it truly means to be seen.

items.title: Hotel Alcohol
items.overview: In the psychiatric hospital, the chief doctor organizes the "Olympic Games," in which protagonists Bako, Medea, and Drago form a group called "Hotel Alcohol." They lose the games, leave the hospital, and head toward the sea.

items.title: Fate
items.overview: The story takes place at a tourist resort in Hurghada, where a wealthy widow inherits the resort following the death of her billionaire husband. While managing the resort, she goes through several romantic experiences in search of a suitable life partner, until she meets a man with whom she falls in love.

items.title: Death of Truth
items.overview: The orderly, solitary life of Feridun is shaken by the arrival of his old friend Timuçin, who carries the burden of murders they committed in the past. As Timuçin contemplates turning himself in, Feridun must stop him to protect his own freedom.

items.title: Patakka Guddiyan
items.overview: Roohi, a simple girl, is the complete opposite of her twin sister Mahi, who is sharp, daring, and mischievous. As the story progresses, layers of suspense and drama unfold.

items.title: XO
items.overview: They are two. They play a game, fight and compete, love and wander, yearn and mourn. They part and reunite, get bored and create, scream and dream. But can they defy the duality?

items.title: Jennifer
items.overview: Jennifer is an Indian movie directed by Althaf Rahman starring Swasika. The feature film is produced by Antony Naduvattom and Binu Dev

items.title: The Smosh Halloween Special
items.overview: Jill, Danny, and Shannon throws a halloween party.

items.title: Bully - Leider Live! Garantiert ohne Programm
On The Line
items.overview: When a teenage boy (Shylo Molina) hangs up on a suicide prevention counselor, (Rosa Salazar) she risks everything to find him. Stealing her boss's car, she sets off on an extraordinary journey that becomes a funny, bittersweet road trip between two strangers who were, only hours earlier, just voices on the line.  Along the way, it becomes clear which one them needs saving.

items.title: When a Witness Recants
items.overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

items.title: We Are Born Good
items.overview: A dining mishap caused a rift between Ji and Rui, leading to a cycle of revenge. Their already troubled lives only came together to fall apart.

items.title: Akāliko Hotel
items.overview: A story of love, greed, and betrayal among a group of people whose lives are intertwined. Now, the time has come for them to settle their past scores once and for all in order to find a way to escape the mysterious Akaliko Hotel.

items.title: Fuxi: Four Tales of Feasting
items.overview: On a seesaw, Sun and Moon rise and fall, witnessing four feasts and festivities spanning four millennia, where the living and the dead, gods and ghosts unite in a simple, shared joy.

items.title: Dreamboat
items.overview: When an underground musician’s unconventional romance with her beloved pillow is violently cut short by her mother, she spirals into a delirious odyssey through Mumbai, where her friendships, desires, and grip on reality are tested by an enigmatic homeless poet. As she searches for love and connection in an increasingly alienating city, the abandoned pillow begins to develop a will of its own.

items.title: 15 Aala Kamra
items.overview: The room features an old cupboard tied with a sacred red thread. Pandit convinces the group that supernatural spirits live inside and warns them never to open it, turning the cupboard into a constant source of fear and humor throughout their stay.

items.title: Peven Everett: Voice of A Generation
items.overview: The incredible untold story of Peven Everett — a prolific Chicago musician, multi-instrumentalist, and the voice of dance music, featuring exclusive in-depth interviews, rare archival material and live performances.

items.title: I'm Nothing Special Really
items.overview: Feri breaks up with her long-term boyfriend when she sees him getting intimate with his ex. Meanwhile, Navid likes Feri's sister Mariam and tries to get close to her, but an unexpected encounter changes the course of their relationship. Still feeling the pain of heartbreak, Feri sets off with Mariam in search of peace of mind.

items.title: All About the Money
items.overview: A son of one of America’s wealthiest families creates a communist revolutionary base in rural Massachusetts as a means of disrupting the capitalist system he grew up in, but has now come to despise. It’s the starting point of an astonishing journey.

items.title: City of Fathers
items.overview: A father and son have nothing in common except a first name, Richard, and an apartment on a housing estate. The burly, good-natured, 30-something factory worker listens to heavy metal and occasionally lets his girlfriend into his life. The frail, retired teacher, who raised the boy after his mother’s departure, is the embodiment of care and understanding. However, their tranquil, shared reality, which embraces both the hardcore band Našrot and Bergman’s “Cries and Whispers,” is disrupted by the sudden death of the mother. Young Richard sets out on a peculiar initiation journey with bizarre encounters and moments of unexpected enlightenment.

items.title: Every Breath We Take
items.overview: A murder investigation in a small rural town, marked by silences and loyalties, uncovers old secrets. Adoniran, a respected investigator, sees his life collapse when he goes from agent to prime suspect. While trying to prove his innocence, Saulo, Special Agent of Internal Affairs, returns to his hometown and must confront memories he would rather forget. Inner conflicts, fragile alliances, and unresolved recollections make the search for truth increasingly dangerous.

items.title: Sandwiched
items.overview: Caught between her insatiable Gen Alpha child and her boundary-lacking Baby Boomer parents, a burnt-out Millennial Mom tries to reclaim her sanity.

items.title: Kentucky Bourbon
items.overview: Hoping to leave behind his battle with alcoholism, Ivory relocates with his wife, Zoë, to an idyllic suburban community. Their fresh start quickly devolves into an uncanny nightmare as their overly hospitable neighbors reveal an insatiable hunger, forcing Ivory to battle both the bottle calling his name and the terror closing in outside his door.

items.title: Homunculus
items.overview: A student photojournalist searches for a missing fellow student on campus, but he realizes the horrifying truth once he enters the dark room.

items.title: Ghostwatch: The Night That Terrified Britain
items.overview: Taking a look back at the 1992 BBC spoof supernatural documentary, when 11 million viewers were taken in by a fake investigation, presented by Michael Parkinson and Sarah Greene, into paranormal activity at a family home in Northolt, North-West London

items.title: Faust
items.overview: After making a deal with the devil, an isolated and unsatisfied professor uses supernatural means to achieve success and happiness at the cost of his soul.

items.title: Hating
items.overview: Ondřej Šálek’s time-lapse documentary captures an escalating street battle between pro-Russian activists at a petition stall in Prague’s Klárov district and a group of liberal-minded citizens who have decided to take justice into their own hands. Footage from live streams and first-hand observations reveal verbal and physical altercations and the growing radicalisation of both camps. This unsettling account of the forms taken by civil resistance in a sharply polarised society does not adopt the perspective of either side. An impartial observation of the actions and counter-actions shows how easily a sense of threat and the desire to belong to a particular community can escalate into aggression.

items.title: Pining for Douglas
items.overview: When an overworked social media manager returns home for Christmas, she finds herself torn between saving her hometown's beloved 150-year-old Douglas Fir and a budding romance with the son of the tech giant's CEO who plans to chop it down.

items.title: Midnight Snack
items.overview: Video Nasties Short Film Challenge participant and superfan Bernard Satariano gets the midnight munchies

items.title: Pani Vizhum Iravu
items.overview: During a trip to a century-old Kodaikanal bungalow, JK reports his lover Shabi mysteriously missing, triggering a tense police inquiry entangled with an unsolved murder, suspicious staff, and local thieves. However, as the investigation deepens, the boundary between reality and illusion shatters, exposing a harrowing confrontation with unresolved grief, guilt, and the fragile human mind.

items.title: Welcome to Dolly's House
items.overview: A young YouTuber, Princess Maria, is determined to reveal the enigmatic secrets of Madame Dolly, a sorceress who can turn lifeless dolls into human beings. But as Princess Maria delves deeper, suppressed and painful memories resurface within her…

items.title: The Anta Claus of the South Pole
items.overview: Envious of his northern counterpart, the Anta Claus of the South Pole embarks on a penguin-powered journey to uncover the secret of a flawless Christmas. Along the way, he learns that the true spirit of the holiday lies not in perfection but in the lovable community of oddballs he left behind.

items.title: Cena Familiar
items.overview: Unable to accept their parents' death, Silvia decides to bring them back to life to celebrate one last family reunion.

items.title: Otter Lake
items.overview: A year in the life of choreographer Emma Portner as she creates new work, confronts personal and physical challenges, and searches for artistic freedom between Otter Lake and Europe.

items.title: Promise Street, 1988
items.overview: While working on the unfinished self-portrait of her bedridden mother, a young woman notices an unknown presence in her house.

items.title: The Manor: First Encounter
items.overview: At the turn of the century, a Manhattan family’s move to an Upstate New York hamlet inadvertently awakens an extra-terrestrial force that torments the community.

items.title: Shores
items.overview: Amina’s life revolves around caring for her aging parents and tending to their family home. A surprise visit from her cousin, Azam, brings back memories from 15 years ago. As they catch up on the years lost, they reminisce about her lost love. The unexpected visit gives Amina the closure she never knew she needed, leaving her at peace with her past and more accepting of her present. Years of conflict are resolved through a homecoming and a simple “knock on the door.”

items.title: The Wrath
items.overview: Newlyweds and documentary filmmakers Devyn and Ben travel to Thailand to capture the legend of Mae Nak—a spirit said to manipulate the living through love and rage.

items.title: The Last Act: Ediz Hun
items.overview: A biographical documentary that chronicles Ediz Hun’s 83-year journey—spanning cinema, academia, and theater—through his roles as an actor, ecologist, and collector, as well as his insatiable curiosity.

items.title: Fortune Tellers Inc.
items.overview: Mai, now ready to enter adulthood, ventures out to the magical Fortune Tellers Inc. where mystical creatures reveal her future. However, after every reading, the object of the prediction materialises to Mai’s astonishment.

items.title: Doma
items.overview: Forced to sell her horse to cover her dying father’s medical bills, a young woman risks everything in a final race to save her father and the horse that carries his legacy.

items.title: All the Way Down
items.overview: Alex, a burnt-out composer, seeks a creative spark when she travels to a mysterious inherited lake property. There, she encounters a family secret and an otherworldly sound that may provide divine inspiration or drive her to madness.

items.title: IceGuys: The Movie
items.overview: When Iceland's hottest boyband ICEGUYS accidentally enters an international reality show competition, they must out-sing, out-dance and out-last other rival boy bands to win a coveted opening slot on an upcoming world tour.

items.title: Little Audrey
items.overview: Based on a true story, an agnostic Jewish child psychologist is recruited to a Vatican investigation of a comatose girl believed to be a “victim soul,” only to find herself pulled into a case where alleged miracles defy reason — and challenge everything she believes.

items.title: A Day Like a Week
items.overview: Stanley Truman is arrested by the police and subjected to an intense interrogation led by Inspector Thomas Pressman, who is determined to uncover the horrifying events that destroyed Stan and his family. But the more Stan reveals, the darker and more disturbing his story becomes…  Hallucinations? Manipulation? Demonic presence?

items.title: Yamazaki Riverside - Over an Actor's Shoulder -
items.overview: The first documentary devoted to actor Yamazaki Tsutomu follows his pursuit of the craft as he confronts old age and cancer.

items.title: Bolio: Spirit of the Mustang
items.overview: Down-on-his-luck high school shop teacher Dale finds himself awkwardly entangled with aspiring life coach, Chuck. Reluctantly accepting Chuck’s power of positive thinking and take-charge approach, Dale begins to come out of his shell. Through their budding friendship, Dale begins to repair what is broken, until he discovers that Chuck may not be all that he seems.

items.title: All Saints Street - The Secret of the Old Castle
items.overview: A Halloween special for All Saints Street. The supernatural roommates of Room 1031 find their daily lives of rent, chores, and bickering interrupted by a mysterious old castle that sends out a summons. Facing an unexpected challenge of "life and death," the demons, vampires, werewolves, and angels must try to maintain their neighborly spirit and stick together through the spooky adventure.

items.title: Your House
items.overview: Four homes share a looming threat.

items.title: Inside
items.overview: Isn't it strange how few personal stories we know about something experienced by millions of women? Inside is a poetic exploration of abortion through the memories of women who have lived it. Fragmented reflections unfold through the language of flowers, archival footage, and abstract imagery, while the world outside presses in through expectations, judgment, and a noise that was never truly theirs to carry.

items.title: This Solitude
items.overview: Leo and Lorea have loved one another. Maybe they still do. But something in them has broken. After five years, their relationship is done. He looks after his sick father, trapped between responsibility and an emotional void that weighs him down. She, caught up in poorly-paid jobs and personal crises, tries to get her life back on track without really knowing where to begin. They are two bodies, tired and alone, pierced by their precarious situation, by unresolved issues, by the emotional legacy of a generation who always seem to come late to everything: to love, to stability, to maturity, to serenity, to personal satisfaction.

items.title: Noutro tempo
items.overview: Beto, a retired soccer player, returns to his city to start a routine job. He stays in a family apartment with his niece Elisa, focused on the preparation of some oppositions. Throughout a day, the story follows her wandering through the streets, in contrast to her daily routine. At the end and at the end of the day both share memories and silences.

items.title: Ancient Blue
items.overview: Kenan Yelkıran, a solitary fisherman whose boat was seized due to his debts, goes missing in the heart of a deadly storm. When he washes ashore two months later—his mind a vast, empty void—the town receives him with a dark and unsettling suspicion. As Kenan struggles to piece together his shattered sense of reality, the cursed spirits of ancient times and the ceaseless whispers of the sea begin to haunt his mind. The time has finally come: Kenan must confront the terrifying secret buried deep within his own consciousness and put an end to this age-old cycle of sin.

items.title: Between Us
items.overview: Estranged after a past incident, Makoto and Kasumi reunite in their high school drama club. Through acting, they rebuild their friendship.

items.title: Mothballs
items.overview: Something is bugging Brian Berger, and all of his work obligations certainly aren’t helping.

items.title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
items.overview: Three friends went to Maine to make a horror film.  They disappeared. Their footage didn't.

items.title: Tenfa
items.overview: In the remote Himalayan village of Kandar, a midwife faces a life-threatening childbirth with no medical recourse. Her only hope lies in finding a wild herb known to heal such cases. The lone person who can identify this herb is an elderly grandmother, living with her teenage granddaughter. So as the three women journey in search - across lands scarred by hydropower projects, they uncover the erosion of both ecology and memory. When an old Kinnauri folksong becomes their guide, tradition and technology converge to revive a fading language, a disappearing landscape, and deep kinship between their people and the earth.

items.title: Criaturas – Uma Aventura entre Dois Mundos
items.overview: Stela is twelve years old and only believes in what she can see, or not at all. Miguel, the youngest brother, believes in everything, especially in what doesn't exist. Two years after the tragic dive that killed their mother, they return to the mythical city of Paraty, where nothing is what it seems.

items.title: The Potentials
items.overview: Teruichi Tsuchiya, 42, is a perpetual assistant to a master manga artist. He feels uneasy about his junior colleague who has debuted as a manga artist, his estranged wife who is a popular voice actress, and for some reason, he is constantly at odds with his daughter, who lives with him and is preparing for her high school entrance exams. Just as a 17-year-old manga series comes to an end, a new manga project comes along. Joining him are Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old editor who is aware of his lack of passion for his work, and Potato Yamada, a headstrong 40-year-old rookie assistant. What future awaits him after taking this step…?

items.title: We're Getting Out of Here Alive
items.overview: A policewoman and a pharmacist fight to control a hostage situation -- one from inside a store, the other from the outside.

items.title: Miracle Summer
items.overview: Mahiro returns to her hometown after a long absence. There, a small miracle quietly awakens memories she has long kept buried deep within her heart.

items.title: Wenn das Licht gefriert
items.overview: Elisabeth has been married to Friedrich for 40 years and they’ve been happy, despite a few setbacks. Not even his Alzheimer’s disease can shake their love. Until one evening, during a TV show about the unsolved murder of their daughter’s best friend—which has remained a mystery for 22 years—Friedrich suddenly mentions details he shouldn’t possibly know.

items.title: The Longest Wait
items.overview: The first feature-length documentary on the journey of the Indonesian National Team. From the struggles on the pitch to capturing moments in the Indonesian national team's dressing room to qualify FIFA World Cup 2026

items.title: Mash Ville
items.overview: In a small rural town, Joo Se-jong sells bootleg alcohol with his two younger brothers. Thing is, someone has died after drinking their liquor, so they must take back the hooch they’ve brewed and sent to the town of Hwaseong, before another person perishes from it. While on a mission to retrieve their deadly booze, they come across two dangerous and homicidal cultists who are terrorizing the villagers. Now, they must also fight for their survival and go up against the murderous duo.

items.title: Seres
items.overview: When a strange object crosses the sky and triggers a global alert, two young couples find themselves trapped in a series of increasingly disturbing events. What begins as a getaway out of town transforms into a struggle for survival as they discover they are being hunted by unknown forces.

items.title: City of Masks
items.overview: Ambition, obsession, and lost love collide in a haunted West End theatre where a disfigured composer, a rising star, and a jealous rival fight for control of a mysterious musical-and the masked legacy that threatens to destroy them all.

items.title: Spying Stars
items.overview: Scientist Anandi visits Hanuman Island to perform the last rites ritual for her father. She is immediately placed in quarantine in a remote hotel due to a pandemic caused by a machine-dominant world. When a mysterious star starts following her, she escapes and seeks refuge with a mother and her transgender daughter.

items.title: What We Call Happiness
items.overview: The small, seemingly disconnected joys of three men and women gradually intersect in the wake of a major incident that threatens the world.
The experience of Maya's grief and despair from a past traumatic experience.

items.title: Директор
items.overview: Lavrenty, the narcissistic club director, is forced to work on a play with an ambitious newcomer. He sees her as a rival and plots against her.

items.title: All She Wants Is
items.overview: A bitter actor puts a curse on a friend who betrayed her.

items.title: RYUJI ⻯⼆
items.overview: The eternal legend etched into Japanese film history, rises again. (remake of the 1983 eponymous film).

items.title: The Stalemate
items.overview: A robber and sheriff, out of bullets and far from town, must negotiate their way out of an absurd, unending chase in the Old West.

items.title: Phantom Hair
items.overview: A couple seeks the help of a psychic after a strange encounter at a Farmer's Market.

items.title: Hostile Architecture
items.overview: Without a place of their own, trans lovers Grace and Billy find intimacy in an extra-dimensional room; but just like the city outside, the room itself threatens to swallow them whole.

items.title: Lamina
items.overview: David spends his days sanding scars out of other people’s marble and wood, making the past look brand new again. Nights he sits outside his ex-wife’s loft like a man waiting for a ghost that never quite arrives. Then one barroom massacre changes everything. A stranger pulls him out of the slaughter a second before the shooting starts, almost like he’d seen it coming.  Now David is becoming unstuck. Moments stutter. Hours repeat. Reality folds in on itself. The stranger offers no explanations, only grim little jobs he calls the Moments. Some things, it turns out, can never be restored.

items.title: living
items.overview: A short documentary set in a chicken slaughterhouse, where, amidst the filth, stench, decaying remains of animal carcasses and swarms of insects, a cat and her kittens manage to survive. In a place so deeply marked by human indifference to the death of other creatures, they paradoxically provide at least a hint of the unyielding desire to play, explore, or simply to live.

items.title: They Made Monsters
items.overview: Joaquin has been raised by his monster-hunting father to kill. But when he hears the eerily humanlike cries of a captured creature, Joaquin begins to question where the true horror lies.

items.title: …And I Saw Your Name on the Dust of the Houses.
items.overview: At seventy-two, my grandmother Rosi wanders among the properties she built in the past as she searches for her place in the world while dealing with the pain of loss and abandonment.

items.title: Love Story Abhimanyu Ki
items.overview: Torn between her first love, Wasim Akhtar, and Abhimanyu Yadav, whom her family pressures her to marry, a simple girl faces a complex journey. Struggling with personal trauma and social expectations, she must navigate her emotions to choose her own path.

items.title: Kärlek och andra diagnoser
items.overview: A romantic dramedy about a young couple on the Autism Spectrum who try to answer life's most difficult question: What the hell do you do when you fall in love?

items.title: The Least of These
items.overview: A hospice nurse clocks in for a shift to care for her elderly patient, knowing he doesn't have much time left. What she doesn't know is that today will pull her into a moral decision, challenging her sense of justice, grace, and humanity.

items.title: Etched In Pavement
items.overview: In a remote corner of Detroit, where the streets echo with both hardship and hope, two young men turn fighting into a language of survival, purpose and community.  Filmed over four years, Etched In Pavement follows Dwane Taylor and Michael Futrell whose weaving paths move through youth combat sports, professional boxing and their grassroots Guns Down, Gloves Up street-fighting movement. As they navigate fatherhood, loss, and those who came before, the film becomes an intimate portrait of generations caught between violence and purpose, survival and legacy.

items.title: In the Shadows
items.overview: Tells the true story of Ramla Ali, who fled Somalia with her family as a young girl, seeking asylum in London from the civil war. As a teenager, she pursued her love of boxing, but did so secretly as she knew her family would disapprove. Ali became the first boxer, male or female, to represent Somalia at the 2020 Olympic Games and made history after winning the first ever professional female boxing match in Saudi Arabia.

items.title: Two Rivers
items.overview: Near the Oder River, where Poland and Germany meet, the two friends Szymon and Franek spend every free moment at the skatepark. A place where everyone comes together, regardless of where they come from.  But as they look across to the other side of the river, their perception begins to shift. The river becomes a border, fences cut through the space, appearing and disappearing again.  Shot on 16mm, this short combines documentary observation and animation and follows two children growing up at a borderland who begin to question what borders really are: something tangible, like the river they are looking at, or something that exists only in their imagination?

items.title: Scream: Short Film
items.overview: After a brutal murder reawakens Woodsboro's dark past, Cora Clemenzo is pulled into a new Ghostface killing spree as her friends in the Woodsboro High Cinema Club become suspects and survival means uncovering the truth before history repeats itself...

items.title: Ungehor§am
items.overview: The documentary follows activists who are fighting for a more just future through civil disobedience, accepting personal risks and legal consequences in the process. The film tells their David-versus-Goliath stories and places today’s protests for climate protection and human rights within the history of nonviolent resistance.

items.title: Xa lyu-k'ya | Un Mundo de Cerros
Land of the Dead: It's for the gays
items.overview: A dark, camp-infused comedy about Mel, a non-binary person coming to terms with their identity. Much to their dismay, Evy ropes them into a Samhain retreat with their friends Remy, Tyler, and Sage. All Hades breaks loose when a demon from Mel's past returns to haunt them all after a seance goes awry. Mel is confronted by the demon they accidentally summoned in childhood - a manifestation of fear, shame, and unresolved identity. While their friends navigate their own Queer expressions through drag makeup, chaotic flirtations, and substance-fueled denial, Mel’s journey unfolds more subtly.

items.title: The Royal Christmas Mix-Up
items.overview: Lilah, a Manhattan-based professional gift concierge, travels upstate to rectify a gifting snafu when her client’s gift – a rare, antique nutcracker intended for the Queen of Monteblanca – accidentally ends up there. Upon her arrival, Lilah learns that the nutcracker has been accidentally designated as the grand prize for the local Christmavaganza Festival, and the only way to retrieve it is to compete in the Yuletide Games… together with her disgruntled client.

items.title: Vanished 2: Legend of the Mask
items.overview: Three friends investigate the mysterious legend of the Masked Monster.

items.title: Bonds, Roots and Passions
items.overview: The story of three survivors of a refugee boat accident. Hazel, a young Syrian woman, finds herself trapped between cultural traditions and family responsibilities. Hamza, after being released from prison, struggles to reconcile with his past while trying to build a new identity and life for himself. Meanwhile, Khaled, an Afghan refugee, survives by working as a shepherd in a small village, but his love for the village headman's daughter clashes with the rigid traditions of the community.

items.title: This Is the One They'll Remember Me By
items.overview: Actress Robin Beck is thrown into a downward spiral when she hears rumors of the upcoming remake for the film that made her a star, PLACES! (dir. Bert Hayley, 1983).

items.title: School Shooters: You Killed Me First
items.overview: After graduating, Jaime and Chloe plan a massacre at their high school during the summer.

items.title: Un segreto da tenere in gola
items.overview: A lonely, rough young farmer gives shelter to a woman who has fled from her abusive husband, sparking a complex bond that tests his rigid daily life.

items.title: Call The Office
items.overview: Call The Office is one of Canada’s most iconic music venues. The venue created a vibrant social hub in London, Ontario and thrived for generations. It brought such notable bands as Radiohead, The Tragically Hip, Bif Naked, D.O.A, Link Wray, and Bad Brains to London. It also helped launch the careers of musicians such as Danko Jones, Sum 41, Kittie, and Death From Above 1979.  From the voices of the bookers, staff, patrons, and bands, this documentary examines what made the place so special.

items.title: Woman Who Sold Her Shadow
items.overview: Yuko Kawai works at an advertising agency in Tokyo, but her ordinary life leaves her anxious about the future. As she nears her 28th birthday, a fortune-teller warns that her next yes-or-no answer could change her fate. Soon, a mysterious man offers to grant her wishes for a year in exchange for her shadow. When success and good fortune begin to arrive, Yuko must ask whether getting everything she wanted will truly make her happy.

items.title: Heritage
items.overview: Fifteen years after leaving Corsica, Marie and Daniel return to visit their elderly grandfather. Looking to capture their reunion, they pick up the family camcorder, but what they uncover is far from what they expected.

items.title: FrankenFiddle
items.overview: A creature encounters a blind hermit.

items.title: Legs, Bums, Tums and Zombies
items.overview: Whilst having a good old-fashioned workout, an unexpected visitor turns up to class and things go sideways. Infected zombie comedy short from Silent Studios, also set to become part of the horror anthology Deadweight Derek's Leisure Emporium.

items.title: Origin Story
items.overview: Sofia (Valentina Herszage), a 20-year-old Brazilian actress, arrives at a casting audition for an American film that quickly departs from the familiar.  ORIGIN STORY explores identity, performance, and the enduring influence of the American gaze upon Latin American culture.

items.title: After the Rehearsal
items.overview: In the garden of a colonial villa in Bujumbura, five actors gather. They were summoned here to rehearse a theatre piece about a future in which all international organisations and NGOs have left East Africa. But now, as the director herself is not there, they cannot do anything but wait, and share a few stories. Nested in a mythological setup with an absent director, an unruly fictional character, a ghost and a wanderer, they tell stories about the sphere of development aid and the inequality it claims to fight.  After an essayistic introduction, their narrations drift between report, fairy-tale and gossip. In an attempt to grasp a an increasingly elusive world, these monologues were developed out of stories, ideas and experiences from 5 years of artistic research and exchange between a Burundian and a German filmmaker.

items.title: El pintor de los milagros
items.overview: After an accident leaves his daughter in a coma, Francisco, a seasoned journalist, tries to rebuild his life by accepting a seemingly minor assignment: uncovering the origins of the ancient mural of the Black Christ, venerated by millions. His search leads him to Santiago, who reveals the untold story of the image's mysterious creator: a young man enslaved in 17th-century Peru, known only as "The Painter." Amid discrimination and suffering, the young man transforms his pain into an extraordinary work: a Black Christ that, over the centuries, would become the most important symbol of faith in our nation and one of the most venerated in the world. As he reconstructs this story of hope, resilience, and redemption, Francisco embarks on a journey that will forever change his understanding of faith and restore his belief that miracles are still possible.

items.title: Edhi Alice: Take
items.overview: Edhi Alice: TAKE begins from the perspective of Alice, a gaffer pushed out of the field, as she confronts her own body, and transitions into the journey of another protagonist, Edhi, who discovers a new sense of embodiment. The narrative of transition expands beyond a personal life story to encompass relationships, bodily experiences, and the sense of space, becoming a cinematic transformation.

items.title: Black Hollow
items.overview: Set in the rural Midwest during the 1970s, Black Hollow follows Jessica, an innocent young girl sheltered by small-town faith and her worldly friend Helen, whose rebellious streak leads them both into danger. When the two sneak out one foggy night, they wander to a forgotten churchyard, an isolated place where sacred ground conceals something unholy. As darkness descends, Jessica's search for belonging turns to horror, forcing her to confront the evil that thrives beneath the surface of the American heartland.

items.title: Sara
items.overview: Sara runs away from a party, overwhelmed by her father's pressure to be the "perfect daughter," and heads out to pursue her passion for photography, determined to do what she loves without fearing the consequences.

items.title: The Meryl Streep Project
items.overview: What began merely as an entertaining performance, the 'Meryl Streep Project' has transformed into an icon of resistance, exposing the realities of women's rights in South Korea. However, following the COVID-19 pandemic, the project has taken an unexpected turn.

items.title: The Man and the Tree
items.overview: The mango tree in Milton "Papa" Kāne"s backyard has been rooted to his family since the day he was born, his piko planted lovingly beneath it. Now facing a terminal illness, and city enforcement demanding the tree"s removal — more costs his family can"t carry — Papa takes matters into his own hands. Before anyone else can decide the tree"s fate, he gives it, and himself, a send-off no one saw coming.

items.title: Verity
items.overview: A man wishes for Verity to be real, but sometimes wishes shouldn't come true.

items.title: The Masturbator - The Adventures of Edgar Hilsenrath
items.overview: This hybrid animated documentary plunges us into the transgressive world of Edgar Hilsenrath, the first German Jewish writer to dare to laugh in the face of the worst. His monumental work, inspired by his experience of the Holocaust, includes seminal titles such as * The Nazi and the Barber* (1971) and *Fuck America* (1980). His masterpiece * Night* , published in the United States in 1976 and an immediate success, was first published in Germany in 1964 before being withdrawn from sale by the publisher due to its explicit content. It remained censored in Germany for nearly 20 years. Without embellishment, detours, or circumlocutions, Hilsenrath's work is that of magnificent losers and inglorious wanderings. It is the incisive acuity of the marginalized on the depths of the human experience.

The Cobweb Hotel is a 1936 animated short film directed by Dave Fleischer and produced by Fleischer Studios. Animated by David Tendlar and William Sturm, the setting is said to be one of Fleischer's desks, which the spider used to open the hoax hotel. Felix Motel, however, will be set in a Bates Motel inspired setting and will feature cameos from various public domain characters that include Tweety Pie, Popeye, Mickey and Minnie Mouse, to name just a few. Felix Hotel will not only pay homage to Psycho, but will have unsubtle nods to Scream, The Texas Chainsaw Massacre, Halloween and American Psycho. items.overview: When Raven receives a mysterious video game called EMULATE, she's excited to try something new. But after a strange encounter inside the game, she discovers that something sinister is watching her. A masked figure has a message for her. And the more Raven plays, the closer he gets to escaping the digital world. With nowhere to run and no way to stop what's coming, Raven is about to discover that some games are better left unfinished.

items.overview: Through interviews with women who have been trained in the craft of making traditional Lepoglava lace we learn about this symbol's role in the creation of Lepoglava's identity and how it connects local women across time and space.

items.overview: A deeper look into Switzerland's counterfeits during WWII.

items.overview: Three sisters, separated from their mother while fleeing, live in a camp in Athens. What does “home” mean when caught between adaptation and uncertainty? And will the family be reunited?

items.title: The Snake Charmer
items.overview: Beyond the lush elds, the area of destruction begins. Thai labourer work in the Israeli elds on the border with Gaza. A robot snake evokes a false sense of security.

items.title: Destin Morillo’s The Noah Movie;The Complete Epic
items.overview: Noah Feliz, A big time gangster, is offered a chance to make some big money when a narcotics/gangster Brian Thompson pays him a visit. But things go wrong very quickly. Watch how the story unfolds in this gangster epic. With acts of violence, betrayal, and fights for power. No one is safe.

items.title: Effigy.mp4
items.overview: When a camping trip goes awry, a couple must double down on their efforts to survive.

items.overview: A mysterious being enters a man's dreams.

items.title: Orestes
items.overview: A son receives a call from his overbearing mother long after her death.

items.title: WATERMARK
items.overview: Bu Rani, a geprek chicken stall owner with a traumatic past of being falsely accused, unknowingly receives a fake 100,000-Rupiah toy bill. When her son attempts to spend the money at a local store, a wave of paranoia triggers an absurd neighborhood raid led by an overzealous RT chief. In a community fractured by distrust and untraceable cash, digital payment becomes their ultimate watermark of truth and redemption.

items.title: Un río de aguas profundas y luminosas
items.overview: In the mid-1970s, as a child, Susana accompanied her father, Pedro Juajibioy, on various journeys throughout the Putumayo region, where he collected plants while dreaming of establishing a botanical garden in his hometown of Sibundoy. Today, together with Susana and Brayan—a young botanist from Sibundoy—we traverse those same paths in the Colombian Amazon, following in the footsteps of Pedro, who is well-known for having accompanied the ethnobotanist Richard Evans Schultes on his explorations of the region between 1941 and 1953. This legacy lives on through the work of Brayan; inspired by Pedro’s original garden—which was destroyed by a landslide in 2000—he has created a new conservation space in Sibundoy and resumed the task of collecting and caring for plants. "A river of deep, luminous waters" accompanies these journeys, revealing how knowledge is passed down through generations and remains vibrant among those who continue to practice it within their own territory.

items.title: Once Upon A Poet
items.overview: When a disillusioned young poet discovers a forgotten script and a decaying flower in a dream, she is thrust into a creative awakening that forces her to confront and find her true voice.

items.title: Terrifying Film
items.overview: This is scary

items.title: Nada Sobre Nosotros
items.overview: Gerardo, a short person, suffers a deterioration in his health that gradually affects his mobility. This leads him to implement an idea that has bothered him for a long time; help make people with disabilities visible through the creation of cinematographic stories.

items.title: Vlog 30
items.overview: When three friends visit their beloved mall one last time, staying after hours becomes a fatal mistake as something begins to hunt them.

items.title: Élégie pour les Lilas
items.overview: The fate of the storied Parisian maternity clinic Les Lilas already seems sealed: it is not pro table enough. An unsentimental elegy about the staff, the patients and their fight.

items.title: The Making of Animol
items.overview: Go behind the scenes of Sky Original film Animol, the highly anticipated directorial feature debut of Ashley Walters, and discover how the film was brought to life.  Featuring exclusive on-set footage and interviews with director Ashley Walters, writer Nick Love, and stars Tut Nyuot, Vladyslav Baliuk and Stephen Graham.

items.title: Last Round
items.overview: A Berlin housing project for homeless men follows a different approach: acceptance, support, dignity instead of forced abstinence. A longitudinal observation of impressive horizontality.

items.title: What Are Friends For?
items.overview: Friends are seen having a disagreement over an issue of serious import.

items.title: Butterflies Don't Fly In The Rain
items.overview: A tragic story of an orphan siblings told through the interrogation of the orphanage master. New take on the aftermath of drugs and the ruin it brings.

items.title: Mother's Household Ledger
items.overview: After moving to a provincial area, I decided to live with my elderly parents and discovered my mother's 50-year-old ledger. At first, it seemed like a simple household record, but as I continued to flip through it, I realized it captured the essence of our family's life. The ledger includes records starting from the day I was born in 1972, revealing various family events, as well as depicting the struggles of my father with unemployment and my mother's diligent management of the household. The ledger, which stopped in 2016, reflected my mother's way of enduring life, and although she is now losing her memory, it allows her to revisit our family's past.

items.title: YED MERYEM
items.overview: he story follows a group of students from Bab Ezzouar University who go on a mysterious, adventure-filled trip from Algiers to Tamanrasset, with plenty of funny moments along the way. Meryem is chosen to protect the legacy of "TinHinan", the legendary Tuareg queen, and keep her heritage from fading away. Things get complicated when a businessman named Youssef tries to sabotage her mission.

items.title: Hide N Seek
items.overview: Alex plays a game that he thinks it's your normal Hide and Seek. He later finds out the game is more sinister than he thought...

items.title: House of the Ripper
items.overview: Three friends decide to spend the night in the long abandoned house of a serial killer only to find themselves viciously killed.

items.title: El Nieto Manuel
items.overview: A call returns Manuel to the town. His grandmother Mima, who for years wrote him letters and reflections, is no longer completely present: her memories have begun to fragment. Manuel decides to read them with her to check what remains, and in that gesture she recognizes her own need to write. For three years he records a file that documents at the same time a relationship and its transformation. While Mima's voice goes out, Manuel finds in the music a way to sustain what is leaving: not to retain it, because he understands that that is not possible, but to accompany it while it is still there.

items.title: Knockadoo
items.overview: As Vivian Fuller continues to wait by his door for someone who's never coming, he must confront a monster he unknowingly created during his isolation inside his home.

items.title: I TAKE STRAYS
items.overview: A quiet disappearance unsettles the seemingly ordinary life of a mother and daughter. As the days pass, subtle cracks begin to appear, leading Mandy toward something she was never meant to find.

items.title: Delicate Darling
items.overview: While she searches for answers, everyone around her seems to have already decided there are none. As certainty slips further out of reach, she finds herself increasingly alone with something no one is willing to name. Delicate Darling is a coming-of-age story about the first time a young girl learns that silence can make you question yourself before you begin to question the world.

items.title: Twisted Tales: Death Contract
items.overview: Five college students tell each other spooky stories that will sure to give you a fright, just might keep you up all night!

items.title: Cinéma corse, la place des femmes
Radiography of Santiago (FM)
items.overview: One day in June 2026, a camera travels through Santiago by car while the radio stays on without pause. Radiography of Santiago captures an ordinary morning in the city through FM signal

items.title: Naaz
items.overview: When Dr Farah Naz retires from her government job, she struggles to keep her private, not-for-profit maternal healthcare clinic in rural Pakistan open amidst operational, infrastructural and personal challenges. As thousands of women rely on her healthcare clinic for affordable healthcare, she is the only hope in the village.

items.title: Free Zone
items.overview: Exarchia, Athens. A place of left utopias and a fiercely contested site of gentrification. For the Iranian activist Abtin, the political struggle becomes a threat to his own freedom.

items.title: StaticTendencies
items.overview: An artistic, experimental short that reflects on the horrors of isolation, loneliness, and addiction. This film challenges its viewers to think abstractly.

items.title: Land of Fire
items.overview: In remote British Columbia, wildfires have become part of everyday life. The communities the film follows carry deep losses, visible in the burned forests and in the roadside posters of missing loved ones, many of them young women. Yet life here is shaped as much by resilience and solidarity as it is by grief.  Nikola Klinger has made a film about people facing complex challenges who nonetheless believe in a better future. By weaving together the interconnected lives of the locals, the film creates a layered portrait of the landscape and the people’s bond with the wilderness, its magic and its myths. Residents live in the shadow of unsolved deaths and the disappearances of young people, finding an escape from their troubles in community solidarity and modern-day rituals, such as the demolition derby at the local wreck yard.  “There is something alive out there in the bush; you can feel it, but you can’t see it.”

items.title: Les Rencontres Extraterrestres Françaises : Recherches & Autopsie
Head over Heels
items.overview: Alondra just wants the perfect wlw yearner fantasy confession she has planned to go right. Step-by-step. Bullet-per-bullet. However, the disembodied voice of a ‘hey mamas-sheesh pare” brodie doesn’t seem to let her.

items.title: Trick or Meat
items.overview: On Halloween night, four friends gather inside a blanket fort to share candy and scary stories. But when Milton’s obnoxious cousin Milhouse takes over with a bizarre tale about a mysterious man dressed as meat, the night takes a strange and unexpected turn.

items.title: TUB
items.overview: Alice, a mad scientist, is obsessed with furniture. She is simultaneously discouraged and inspired by the lack of creativity in the modern day furniture industry. She is impassioned to carry out a series of transgressive, experimental projects where she knows no bounds for her creative vision.

items.title: Chloe
items.overview: An experimental short film that explores fragile relationship between memory, identity, and desire to preserve what time inevitably takes from us.

items.title: Final March
items.overview: A soldier returns home from a long combat deployment, his house seems different than he remembers

items.title: Geographies of Home
items.overview: Two brothers, one living in Mexico City and the other in Berlin, undertake an experimental audiovisual correspondence. Through a series of short video-letters, they explore their personal experiences of migration, home, and belonging. Blending found footage, family archives, original images and soundscapes, the project takes the form of an intimate visual dialogue. What begins as individual reflections gradually evolves into a collaborative process in which both brothers revise, edit, and respond to each other’s material. Rooted in visual anthropology and autoethnography, the film raises a central question: how do we construct a sense of place and belonging when we no longer live in the country of our origin? A quiet, non-linear exploration of displacement and the seek for a home.

items.title: One Percent Chance
items.overview: A hot date turns ice cold when Annie and Jason realize they have more in common than they hoped.

items.title: Gadi
items.overview: A man living in a small Konkan hamlet who is grieving the loss of his child learns that he has no free will.

items.title: Separation Anxiety
items.overview: Separation Anxiety is a thriller/horror short film. It follows a group of friends going camping when their friend goes missing and the go on a quest to find him. Their concerns quickly turn from searching for their friend to survival.

items.title: Jaunt
items.overview: In a stark warehouse office, Justice is weighed down by mounting deadlines and an endless to-do list. But every day, he finds escape in a one-hour ritual that reignites his spirit.

items.title: Demonology
items.overview: A small team of paranormal investigators are hired to investigate a remote property where a grieving couple claims to have encountered a demonic force. As they unravel the mystery, they begin to realize they are not welcome.

items.title: Bleed Out
items.overview: In a post-apocalyptic world, The Dawn taught his people to survive by wearing a mask, no more feeling, no more pain. He has been hiding behind his own ever since he lost Ava.  Alone in the desert, his memories come back, and with them an idea he had never imagined, there might be a way beyond this world.  He returns to his group, gathered in an abandoned warehouse, and takes off his mask in front of them for the first time. But no one understands. So he dances, alone at first, until someone else takes off their mask, then another. In the rain, they dance through the night, until exhaustion, until dawn breaks.

items.title: Anthony Lin's The Lull
items.overview: Camp Counselor Jason wakes up inside an empty car. Scared out of his mind, things unseen haunt Jason as he must come face-to-face to an eerie consequence lurking. Lurking all around him till his night’s end.

items.title: Lovesick
items.overview: A young woman, over a series of nights, deals with the fallout of her girlfriend contracting a behaviour-altering disease.

items.title: Missing Halloween: If I’m Not Around
items.overview: A mini prequel exploring the lore behind the missing girl

items.title: The Ring
items.overview: Alone in his apartment, a man begins to suspect he just might not be.

items.title: KILL YOUR IDOLS
items.overview: KILL YOUR IDOLS is a collection of 17 music videos by bleood, presented as a single feature-length work. Moving between nocturnal city footage, ghostly figures, and eerie, ritualistic imagery, the film plays like a dark visual album about worship, obsession, and the urge to tear down what you once looked up to.

items.title: Lights out
items.overview: Desperate to escape his own life, a shy young man becomes captivated by a girl at a café and attempts to approach her, only to discover that reality is far less appealing than the fantasy he has created in his mind, leaving him unable to find a genuine connection.

items.title: The Morale
items.overview: After the deaths of David Nightingale’s wife and daughter, he arranges a meeting with the CEO who indirectly killed them.

items.title: The Cost of Dreaming
items.overview: Every year, millions of people decide to pursue a creative career. Few are prepared for what it asks of them. Through deeply personal stories from artists across different disciplines, The Cost of Dreaming explores the sacrifices, uncertainty and emotional reality hidden behind the pursuit of artistic success

items.title: Movie Ranch Massacre
items.overview: “Set in 2015, three Los Angeles area horror movie podcast hosts, Tina, Daisy, and Kenny decide to sneak onto an iconic Hollywood movie ranch (with a dark past) on Halloween night to vlog the famous farmhouse for their Youtube channel.”

items.overview: A theater by BE Drama club

items.overview: A mysterious figure intrudes the life of two people forcing them to decide which of them will get to remain.

items.overview: On Halloween night, a man sets out on a solitary walk through the streets of Dublin. Unbeknownst to him, his friends are trailing close behind in the shadows, determined to uncover the mystery of where he goes when he thinks no one is watching.

items.title: Between Herds and Horizon
items.overview: Set in Ladakh’s Changthang plateau, this observational documentary follows Changpa nomads and their pastoral way of life. As climate change, shrinking pastures and changing aspirations reshape their world, they navigate an uncertain future while holding onto their traditions and identity.

items.title: Dealers of Hate
items.overview: Across Central Europe, reports are mounting of Ukrainian refugees — the vast majority women and children — facing harassment and attacks. What’s really behind the headlines about Ukrainians, who were welcomed with open arms in 2022, now facing hatred and hostility? And what role do local politicians play in fueling the violence?  The Kyiv Independent’s new documentary investigates anti-Ukrainian aggression in Germany, the Czech Republic and Poland, the countries that have taken in the largest numbers of Ukrainian refugees since Feb. 24, 2022. Journalist Danylo Mokryk and his team uncover the stories of Ukrainian women who have faced harassment and analyze tens of thousands of posts on X, revealing how hate speech on social media and in political rhetoric escalates into real-world violence.

items.title: Prelude / Epilogue To A Horror Movie
items.overview: A classic 'knife' murder scene between two people who never appear in the same shot.

items.title: Heartbeat
items.overview: In Mumbai’s Bhavani Nagar slum, domestic worker Vimal and her daughter Sonali reflect on education and ambition. Vimal never attended school and hoped Sonali would secure an office job, but Sonali was diagnosed as a “slow learner.” The film portrays their bond with work, learning, and each other.

items.title: HUMAN DICK
items.overview: What happens when zombies take over a film class?

items.title: Brew before you cry
items.overview: In a small coastal town, a ridiculous yet suspicious fatal accident puts a widower under everyone’s watch. A claims investigator who’s been on the losing end for far too long decides this might just be his one shot at getting something right.

items.title: One Scan Away
items.overview: Stranded walletless in Japan during his sister’s medical emergency, an Indonesian student finds his ultimate lifeline in a single QR code.

items.title: Payong
items.overview: When a girl’s heirloom umbrella mistakenly gets taken by the student next door, she finds herself caught in a chaotic chase to retrieve the one thing she cannot afford to lose.
