items.overview: A surreal horror short film about a man trying to remember what just happened.

items.title: Bad Trip
items.overview: A person struggles to maintain their sense of time.

items.title: All Because of Rosie
items.overview: Markus Ethan and Jake Johnson take a chaotic and life-changing detour while on the way to Rosie's Halloween rager.

items.title: Diamonds in the Rough
items.overview: Trust is questioned when Victor finds out his cleaner, Esme, is not all that she seems.

items.title: PaperMan
items.overview: A lonely man accidentally brings a paper to life and has to deal with the consequences.

items.title: The Wonder Years I: It's Not Too Late / Maybe You're The Same As Me
items.overview: Filmed in Mexico City and Santa Barbara, CA. July 2024.

items.title: Giring
items.overview: A Malaysian film that immerses audiences in a story full of challenges, conflict, and human struggle as they face life and the choices that determine the future. With direction by Marlin Brandon, the film promises a cinematic experience close to society and rich with human values and messages.

items.title: I See No Death
items.overview: The film follows a newly formed Ukrainian unmanned systems unit from its first deployment in the Donetsk region and on to operations on Russian territory. The daily lives of these modern-day warriors unfold in cold cellars and trenches, where destruction becomes a technical task and death is reduced to a few pixels on a monitor.

items.title: Sketchy
items.overview: In half-drawn Sketchtown, a stick-man courier has three days to get a half-inked starlet and her three keys to the top of the Tower before the glossy, AI-smoothed Final Cut polishes away everything unfinished. With Uwe Boll as himself.

items.title: Final Form
items.overview: A traffic warden achieves his final form.

items.title: Love Bug
items.overview: After a devastating breakup leaves a young woman heartbroken and alone, an unlikely friendship brings her true self to light.

items.title: G.I.Z.M.O.
items.overview: After tech-wiz Andrew Miller gets hacked himself, he follows a set of mysterious coordinates to an unknown facility, where curiosity gets the better of him.  Part of 48 Hours 2026

items.title: The Mountains
items.overview: As the guerrilla group disintegrates following Girón’s death, a female guerrilla fighter dictates to a comrade the final letter she is sending to her mother.

items.title: Tutuvi
items.overview: A glimpse into the life, work, community, and collaborations of Japanese-Korean artist and designer Colleen Kimura.

items.title: Still Life
items.overview: On a split screen two parallel and contrasting narratives unfold. The world of art and the realm of the everyday are integrally connected and yet hugely disparate. A pair of hands working relentlessly inside a home fade away; while a painting hanging quietly in a museum gains fame.

items.title: Big Tree Guardian
items.overview: Ten years ago, Dr. Hsu discovered a Taiwan cypress bound by steel cables in the mountains, sparking a long rescue journey. The "Tree Seekers" team traveled across Taiwan, developing tree-climbing and cable-removal skills to free giant "cable trees." They rescued Song Yun-Yun, Iron Man, Kingma, and Fat Tiger. Returning to the original tree after a decade, they removed its restraints and named it "Sun Wukong." This film follows a decade-long journey of rescue, memory, and forest connection.

items.title: Egg Hunt
items.overview: Suspicion takes hold of parents and children alike when cryptic surprises are discovered during an Easter egg hunt.

items.title: Ephemeral: part 1
items.overview: On the last day of sixth grade, a boy walks one final time through the hallways, classrooms, and the places where he grew up alongside his friends. What seems like an ordinary day gradually turns into a quiet farewell. As the hours pass, every conversation, every laugh, and every corner takes on new meaning. For some chapters do not end with a grand event, but with a final moment we only truly understand once it has already gone by. *Ephemeral* is a story about childhood, the passage of time, and those everyday moments that—without warning—become lifelong memories.

items.title: Bruce Springsteen and the E Street Band: Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour (Philadelphia Freedom Cut): Part Four
items.overview: Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band have shared the fourth and final installment of “Land of Hope and Dreams American Tour: Philadelphia Freedom Cut,” featuring official video of the full encore from that May 30 show. Kicking off with “American Land” and building to signature live staples “Born to Run,” “Dancing In The Dark” and “Tenth Avenue Freeze-Out,” the performance concludes with The E Street Band version of Bob Dylan’s classic “Chimes Of Freedom.”

items.title: Punk Brighton
items.overview: The documentary utilizes 15 years of interviews, live performance archives, and animation to capture the city's fierce DIY music scene. Rather than focusing solely on the music, it explores how the communal movement tackled broader political and social issues, including confronting fascism, rocking against racism, and rallying the community to save the Brighton & Hove Albion Football Club.

items.title: The Straitjacket Escape
items.overview: Famed escape artist Harry Houdini performs one of his signature feats: freeing himself from a straitjacket while suspended in the air. Here. Now. Experience the marvel and mystery of the master magician.

items.title: Crimson
items.overview: At a crowded passport renewal office in Tehran, Neda, a young modern woman, clashes with Yasser, a conservative man, when she refuses to retake his passport photo.

items.title: Opetael
items.overview: When 19-year-old artist Megi is rejected from her dream art school, her childhood imaginary friend, Opetael, mysteriously reappears. Together, they must figure out who is the serial killer who murdered the course's top three accepted applicants - before the killer strikes again...

items.title: The Bard of the Mountain Valley
items.overview: A magical little musician goes on a quest to earn a song of healing from the Mountain Queen and save her ailing older brother.

items.title: Lunar July
items.overview: When the gates of the spirit world open during Ghost Month, getai becomes more than just a show. Rooted in Malaysia`s Hungry Ghost Festival traditions, the film explores the taboos and unspoken rules behind the getai stage, and the price of breaking them.

items.title: UZUN YAYLA
items.overview: On an ordinary day when Elbruz goes out to fish, he finds himself trapped in a deadlock after refusing, despite pressure from the people in his village, to rent out his land.

items.title: The Fragrance Of Return
items.overview: Fennel is an herb, vegetable, and medicine with a pungent aroma that divides people—some adore it, others despise it. Rarely eaten in Taiwan, it remains a fading memory in the food culture of the Dapu Hakka in Dongshi–Shigang. Shuling returns home to grow and promote fennel, hoping to revive its taste, though many challenges await her...

items.title: The Last Transmission
items.overview: At an undisclosed location in a decaying future, “Last Transmission Live” briefs international treasures before sending them to the stars to represent the human race. When KEVIN ELSON becomes the 34th guest, a mysterious nearby local begins to track him  down.

items.title: Silay
items.overview: A wistful college girl, grows an insatiable longing for another girl who seems to follow her everywhere she goes. But whenever she tries to close the distance between them, chance seems to always pull them apart.

items.title: Call of the Void
items.overview: After being benched and replaced right before the regional basketball championship, an unstable perfectionist begins to spiral into a nightmare of her own creation.

items.title: You Should Dream of Flying
items.overview: Children’s games, school essays and driving lessons: summery snapshots that circle around each other from the everyday lives of refugees, held together by the hope of returning to normality.

items.title: The Things We Bury
items.overview: When you think all is lost, how do you get back at the world and make sure your family goes down with it?

items.title: The Autoharp Crushing on Hot Guys
items.overview: A conversation between friends about relationships and feelings is developed in an imaginative, colorful animation. Despite their different life experiences, which are also influenced by the fact that one of the girls has Down syndrome and the other doesn‘t, they both deal with similar issues. What if they had The Autoharp Crushing on Hot Guys.

items.title: They took my husband
items.overview: When her husband is detained by ICE, Chelsea, MA resident Brenda Romero must take over his construction business, manage her family’s increasingly precarious finances and navigate looming homelessness. Along the way, she becomes a vocal immigrant rights advocate fighting for her family - and for a community in the crosshairs of a federal immigration crackdown.

items.title: We entered as blacks, and we left as afrodescendants
items.overview: The memory of an Afro-Chilean family is permeated by the memory of Rosa Corvacho (1921-2011), their grandmother and matriarch, awakening in them a process of regression, where the bodies, voices and family gestures reactivate the denied history of Black Chile, such as Chileanization, the whitening policies of the north of the country and how these families lived in the daily life of the 20th century.

items.title: Burns Like A Shot
items.overview: When her best friend accidentally drinks her truth serum, a driven young scientist must reverse the effects before the unfiltered honesty between them burns down everything they've never said to each other.

items.title: Flowers We Couldn’t Touch
items.overview: A tribal girl and her mother struggle to hold onto their land as conflict between the state and an armed resistance movement tightens around their community.

items.title: Leading Your Birds
items.overview: Seita is a musician living in Tokyo who is facing a severe creative block. He disappears, and his sister, Azumi, a young deaf girl, finds him in the mountain house where they spent their childhood. Isolated, he tries to get back to composing and begins recording birdsong for inspiration. The two brothers start living together there. Azumi's presence, movements and sounds, which initially irritate Seita, help to unlock the boy's creativity over time. However, the artist becomes bothered again when Taichi, Azumi's boyfriend, decides to pay a visit.

items.title: Dissidence - Two Shadows on the Wall
items.overview: Ravianto and Raviandi Ramadhan are two newcomers to the World Climbing Championships scene. Driven only by passion and lofty aspirations, two Indonesian twin brothers set out into the world without sponsors. The documentary "Dissidence" chronicles their incredible trip from the fabled crags of France to the climbing walls of their native country. It is a heartfelt homage to their bravery, fraternity, and tenacity. Ravianto and Raviandi fight to have their views heard internationally while challenging the current quo.

items.title: Matière noire : la traque de l'invisible
May I come in?
items.overview: ‘I wish I was not a human’  A heartbroken Arya tries to get rid of her human feelings. Veronica, your friendly vampire shows up with all her charm and wisdom to help fulfill her wish.  In this queer horror rom-com Arya dances, cries, falls in love and risk it all afterall there is nothing to fear but love itself.

items.title: WABBIT
items.overview: A man is gifted a mysterious mask that causes him to lose his mind.

items.title: Death Castle

items.title: Forget-me-not

items.title: Flow Vision
items.overview: There is something that has always excited Ambroise in Downhill Skateboarding: it's those moments you experience two or three times in a season or even in your life. He has only experienced this a few times in his life while skating, so he decided to skate the most challenging road in Europe to immerse himself in this mental state — the flow state.

items.title: Cut!
items.overview: A perfectionist director cannot get the last scene of his movie right, so he retakes, and retakes, and retakes...until it's just right.

items.title: Pneumothorax

items.title: Time's Up

items.overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.

items.title: Traces of Justice
items.overview: The film follows criminal police officer Cui Xun over half a century of investigative work. Alongside his colleagues, he solved numerous major cases while staying true to his original aspiration of 'serving the people.' This legendary detective not only witnessed the evolution of China's public security system but also stood as a living testament to the rise of New China.

items.title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
items.overview: A female Kurdish-Norwegian sniper returns to the battlefield she once escaped, driven by vengeance and by the desperate hope of rescuing her younger sister, still imprisoned by ISIS in Mosul.

items.title: The Diary of a Chambermaid
items.overview: A young Romanian woman living in France works for a French family and joins a theatre company who are adapting Octave Mirbeau's The Diary of a Chambermaid.

items.title: Let's Have Kids!
items.overview: Two best friends, Emma and Phoebe, decide to get pregnant simultaneously to navigate motherhood together, but their friendship is tested when only one of them conceives.

items.title: Detective Conan: The Counterfeit Case of Ultra 30
items.overview: As a new 10,000-yen banknote featuring the Touto Tower design is issued and the nation is swept up in excitement, Conan and the Junior Detective League, accompanied by Professor Agasa, Ran, and Sonoko, visit the Nagano factory of the Japan Banknote Printing Bureau. Meanwhile, counterfeit money is discovered at the scene of a murder in Tokyo, prompting the Metropolitan Police Department to establish an investigation headquarters. As the unprecedented circulation of counterfeit new banknotes throws the public into confusion, Conan and Heiji head to Osaka, where the counterfeit money is believed to have been printed.

items.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
items.overview: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

items.title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
items.overview: On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset, and work ethic that made him one of the most legendary artists of his time.

items.title: A Knight to Remember
items.overview: A statue of an English knight arrives in Chicago for an art exhibit. While cleaning the statue, museum conservator Emily impulsively kisses the statue, bringing him to life.

items.title: The River Train
items.overview: Nine-year-old Milo lives in a remote Argentinian village where he studies the Malambo, a folk dance full of bravura. He is an excellent dancer, but Milo’s only desire is to escape the countryside on a train for the Buenos Aires of his dreams.

items.title: World Champion
items.overview: In just a few years, Geoguessr and its small community have grown tremendously. What used to only be a fun geography game has evolved into a competitive esport with incredibly skilled players. One year ago, Lennli took a big step and decided to make Geoguessr and content creation his job in order to fully commit to training and being a pro player. In this 90-minute documentary we accompany him on this journey and learn about everything that is required to be able to compete on the highest level. What drives players? What challenges do they face? And how do they see the future of the esport?
